market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues with Nasdaq near record, but oil volatility and midterm political noise create chop. Tech leads on AI momentum; energy whipsaws on geopolitical headlines. Crypto momentum strong but $85K BTC risks profit-taking. Fed speakers (Williams, Collins) keep rate-cut expectations muted. Watch for diesel export ban resolution.
market_outlook.long_term: Goldman's double-digit S&P earnings growth forecast supports 6-12 month upside, but AI labor displacement, fiscal indiscipline, and structural energy shortages cap enthusiasm. Defense backlogs and LNG demand provide multi-year tailwinds. AI capex cycle likely continues but rotation from application to infrastructure/hardware expected. Midterm outcome will be pivotal for fiscal and regulatory direction.
